Title: Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Java 25

Body.Content:
You can now develop functions using Java 25 locally and deploy them to Azure Functions on Windows and Linux. 

 

Upgrade your apps to Java 25 to take advantage of enhanced security, a longer support window, and continued compatibility with the Azure Functions runtime and developer tools. 

 

Learn more: 

  • Java support in Azure Functions 
  • Upgrade your app to Java 25
